# Sites by Max

> Freelance website design for small businesses of every kind: restaurants,
> bakeries, landscapers, salons, nonprofits, pressure washing crews and more.
> Custom, mobile-first sites with a free preview first, a flat build fee and
> pay-what-you-want hosting. Built and run by Max Lichter, remote, serving the
> United States.

## Services
- Website build for small businesses — free preview first, then a flat $10.46 build fee
- Website hosting — pay-what-you-want, monthly
